description: This file contains functions for managing and processing HTTP requests within a web server. It includes initialization, resetting, copying, validation, and parsing of request data structures, as well as functions for cleaning up associated resources.

classes.name: liRequest
classes.description: A data structure representing an HTTP request, including method, URI components, headers, and body parameters.

classes.name: liPhysical
classes.description: A data structure representing the physical properties of a requested resource, such as path and document root.

classes.name: liConnection
classes.description: A data structure representing a client connection, including request, connection info, SSL status, and response details.

classes.name: liVRequest
classes.description: A structure representing a virtual request, including the associated liRequest and context.

methods.name: void li_request_init(liRequest * req)
methods.description: Initializes an liRequest structure by setting default values and allocating necessary resources.

methods.name: void li_request_reset(liRequest * req)
methods.description: Resets an liRequest structure to a clean state without freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: void li_request_clear(liRequest * req)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an liRequest and clears all data fields.

methods.name: void li_request_copy(liRequest * dest,const liRequest * src)
methods.description: Copies the contents of one liRequest structure to another, duplicating all data.

methods.name: void bad_request(liConnection * con,int status)
methods.description: Sets connection parameters to indicate a bad HTTP request (static function).

methods.name: gboolean request_parse_url(liVRequest * vr)
methods.description: Parses and normalizes the URL in the request, verifies method constraints, and updates the request's URI components.

methods.name: gboolean li_request_validate_header(liConnection * con)
methods.description: Validates HTTP headers of a request, checks for protocol correctness, header consistency, and required headers.

methods.name: void li_physical_reset(liPhysical * phys)
methods.description: Resets an liPhysical structure to a default state.

methods.name: void li_physical_clear(liPhysical * phys)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an liPhysical structure.
